action_summary: A bound capability may no longer write its verified artifact over the file the sentence told it to read. Measured on main e2d7981: "Fix the ZeroDivisionError in <repo>/app/utils.py." replaced 14 lines of source with a tree-sitter parse report (3/3 deterministic) and "Who last changed the function line_total in <repo>/app/service.py?" -- a READ-ONLY question -- replaced 358 lines of source with a JSON symbol index; both then reported FAIL_CLOSED with the source gone. The trigger is not the sentence: every software-engineering row declares output_path=${input.output_path} and source_root=${input.source_root}, so a goal that names no destination leaves the binder exactly one stated path -- the source. The repository already states the rule in one direction (goal_compiler._path_named_after_output_verb: a path named as a DESTINATION is never a candidate SOURCE, with canonical/tests/test_output_destination_is_not_an_input_candidate_v1.py); this lands the dual at the two functions every bound adapter is invoked through (live_brain_route_admission_v1.run_adapter_locally and astra_runtime._invoke_bound_capability), so it covers the door, the composer and every composed step without editing 125 registry rows or the per-adapter _safe_output copies. A capability whose own id says it transforms source (rename/refactor/repair/patch/...) may still replace the file it names; the vocabulary is the registry's own effect vocabulary already used by swe_typed_plan_v1._effect_consistent. No new capability, no registry change, no model, no spend, no protected path.

falsification_condition: FALSIFIED if a source file named by a request is still replaced by a capability report; if the refusal costs a working route (Index the symbols in <dir> and save the index to <out> must still pass); if a source transformer is refused when it replaces the file it names; if a NEW report written beside the source is refused; if the pre-existing failure set of the 13 touched suites differs from pristine main; or if any measured oracle degrades.

load_bearing_primary.interpretation: Every coding obligation is measured by what the machine did to a repository. A run that answers by replacing the repository with its own report cannot be a row in any of them, and worse, it makes the row unreproducible because the fixture is gone. Write authority is therefore substrate for every coding obligation, not a feature.
load_bearing_primary.measured_effect: Seven sentences through the live front door on fresh trees: before the change 2 of 7 left a source file replaced by a capability report (Fix the ZeroDivisionError in <repo>/app/utils.py and Who last changed the function line_total in <repo>/app/service.py); after the change 0 of 7, and the four working routes (dependency graph, symbol index, public API audit, run the suite) still pass. 12 new fresh-instance tests pass, including a mutation control that drops the source slots and a negative control that keeps a working index request passing.
load_bearing_primary.stop_condition: STOP when no bound capability can write its artifact over a file the same action reads, when a source transformer and a new report beside the source are both still permitted, and when the failure set of the touched suites is identical on pristine and patched trees.

measured_effect: Live front door, fresh trees, filesystem as oracle: source replaced by a capability report fell from 2 of 7 sentences to 0 of 7; working routes 4 of 7 pass both before and after. New suite test_a_capability_may_not_overwrite_the_file_it_reads_v1.py: 12/12 pass, including the door-level end-to-end cases and the mutation control. A/B on 13 existing suites touching output_path and adapter invocation (122 tests): the failure set is IDENTICAL on pristine e2d7981 and on the patched tree (5 pre-existing failures: a_defect_is_never_reported_as_a_refusal, an_output_is_not_a_file_the_caller_must_supply, output_destination_is_not_an_input_candidate x2, bound_capability_evidence_and_kernel_native_dispatch), so the rule costs nothing that was green.

obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: Refusing every output under a source root loses on a measured working route (a new report beside the source). Restoring after the fact loses because the write has already happened and the bytes are gone. Per-adapter rules lose on duplication across 125 rows. A capability-name allowlist loses because it is hand-maintained and would rot; the transformer vocabulary is already in the registry.
routes_ranked: one predicate at the two invocation choke points wins over per-adapter rules, because the condition is identical in every adapter
reading the transformer allowance from the capability's own id wins over a hand-maintained allowlist, because the vocabulary already exists and cannot drift from the registry
refusing only an existing source file wins over refusing the whole source root, because a new report beside the source is a measured working route
checking before the adapter runs wins over restoring afterwards, because the bytes are already gone when the check runs afterwards
